name: THE COLONEL'S WREATH
note: EXTRACTED from docs/118-objects-the-lines.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 245). Do not edit: change doc 118 and re-run. Taken from Pike's marker once the town has gone down (errata 246); laid on his own coffin in Act III. Nothing depends on it.

LOOK_AT.say: Colonel Fanshawe's wreath, on my arm, like a wheel going to be mended. SINCERELY, it says.
repeat: It has already been to one funeral for a man the Colonel did not know. It may as well go to another.
The lilies are wax. I should have guessed. They will outlast us both.

LISTEN_TO.say: Wire and wax. It creaks like a gate.
repeat: Nothing. It is saving itself for the occasion.
